_comment: Index of the Pokémon Rulings Compendium's 'all rulings by date' page (https://compendium.pokegym.net/all-rulings-by-date/). It holds no ruling text: the questions and answers (TPCi Rules Team / Japanese Q&A as published by the Compendium) stay on compendium.pokegym.net/ruling/<id>/. Each entry is the ruling id, its date, the card / attack / Ability names it is filed under, its source label, and a hash of question + answer so scripts/rulings-sync.ts can tell when a ruling is new or was edited. Do not edit by hand.
